description: This file is a C++ header defining the Store2 class, which implements various storage-related interfaces (IStore2, IStoreCache, IStoreInspector, IStoreLimit) for a persistent SQLite-based storage system. It includes methods for setting, getting, deleting keys, managing namespaces, and handling storage limits, along with internal mechanisms for database integrity checking and notifications.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: A class implementing storage interfaces with SQLite backend, providing key-value store functionalities, namespace management, cache flushing, and limit enforcement, with notification support for changes.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class within Store2 that dispatches value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair under a namespace with optional TTL, triggering notifications on change.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key under a namespace.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Removes a key from the storage within a namespace.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace and its contents.

methods.name: FlushCache
methods.description: Flushes the SQLite cache for improved consistency.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage size limit for a namespace.
